representative tony grampsas task force legislative chair derek crawford task force private sector chair pay pop re task force scholarship date march 17 1995 the 1995 state legislative sessions are under way and many battles and opportunities are upon us the american legislative exchange council s alec tax fiscal policy task force is well situated to educate policymakers on responsible tax and spending strategies in the quest for more responsible government the task force was very active in 1994 and has decided to take an even more visible role this year 1995 has brought many opportunities and we are excited about the prospect of accomplishing many goals that were once thought unrealistic to capitalize on these new opportunities the task force set forth a proposed agenda for the year during the december orientation meeting in washington d c ideas for projects include publishing a book focused on state tax and spending policy holding tax and fiscal policy forums in certain states conducting regional task force meetings producing state factors issue briefs and policy reports drafting new state model legislation implementing this ambitious agenda of proposed projects will require resources the task force has traditionally avoided developing a budget but surpassing the opportunities now upon us would be an unfortunate course to take we are asking each private sector member of the task force to annually volunteer to contribute 1 000 to the tax fiscal policy task force scholarship budget your assistance will have a direct impact on the success of the task force and will directly influence state strategies calling for fiscal restraint please note that on thursday may 18th the tax fiscal policy task force will meet during alec s national leadership summit in richmond virginia a portion of the operating budget will be used to cover expenses that will enable legislative members to attend the task force meeting we hope you will be able to attend the meeting
